issue_title: A setting passed at startup is ignored when also present in the config file
issue_body: Providing a value for a setting when starting the server has no effect if that same setting also appears in the configuration file; the configuration file value is used instead. A startup value for a setting that is not in the configuration file takes effect normally.
prompt: Providing a value for a setting when starting the server has no effect if that same setting also appears in the configuration file; the configuration file value is used instead. A startup value for a setting that is not in the configuration file takes effect normally.
expected_behavior: A --setting flag at runtime overrides the same key in datasette.json.
Settings present only in datasette.json still apply when no --setting flag is given.
Default values remain when neither datasette.json nor --setting provides a value.
Validation for invalid setting types is unaffected.
